description: This file implements the SecurityContext class for managing access control within a plugin. It includes methods to check permissions for Web requests and JSONRPC messages, along with a constructor that initializes the security context based on provided payload data.

classes.name: SecurityContext
classes.description: A class that manages security and access control for plugin requests, handling permissions for Web requests and JSONRPC messages.

methods.name: SecurityContext::SecurityContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the security context based on ACL, payload, and service prefix.

methods.name: SecurityContext::Allowed (const string& path)
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade is allowed for a given path.

methods.name: SecurityContext::Allowed (const Web::Request& request)
methods.description: Checks if a Web request is authorized based on the path and ACL.

methods.name: SecurityContext::Allowed (const Core::JSONRPC::Message& message)
methods.description: Checks whether a JSONRPC message is permitted.
